raw_sections.personal_information: Senior Analyst — Hedge Fund Accounting & Portfolio Data Operations Hyderabad, India | +91-8839814257 | jayeshyadavpimr2022@gmail.com
raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Senior Fund Accounting & Operations professional with 4+ years of experience supporting global hedge funds across the full trade lifecycle. Managed daily reconciliations across 12+ funds with $32B combined AUM and played a pivotal role in launching two new funds ($4B and $120B AUM) from onboarding through full operational readiness. Deep expertise in Geneva Accounting Engine, multi-asset reconciliations (equities, fixed income, FX, OTC derivatives, futures), NAV finalization, and prime brokerage operations. Experienced in client- facing fund onboarding, data integration into Arcesium systems, and cross-functional collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams. Proven ability to drive process automation using Python, SQL, and Power BI — measurably reducing manual effort and operational risk. Buikt ETL workflows. Big Four mid- and year-end audit engagements.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Geneva Accounting Engine (NAV & Config)
Prime Broker & Custodian Reconciliation
Middle Office & Post-Trade Operations
OTC Derivatives, private Equity, Futures & FX Operations
Corporate Actions Lifecycle Management
P&L calculations and valuations
Collateral & Margin Management
Fund & Investor Reporting (Quarterly/Annual)
Process Automation & Risk Controls
Client & Fund Onboarding (PB, EBS, Exchanges)
Big Four Audit Management (Mid/Year-End)
Python | SQL | Power BI | Advanced MS Excel | Ai tools
Technical Skills: Python | SQL | Power BI | Advanced Excel | Bloomberg (Basic)
POFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
raw_sections.experience:
Arcesium India Private Limited | Hyderabad | Dec 2022– Present ( Client - JP morgan, DE SHAW)
Senior Analyst – Hedge Fund Accounting & Data Operations (FinOps) | Jan 2025 – Present
Managed daily reconciliations across 12+ funds with $32B combined AUM covering trade, position, cash, MTM, spot FX, NAV, and prime broker breaks resolving all discrepancies within SLA with zero escalations to senior management.
Oversaw the complete trade lifecycle across & exposure private equities, fixed income, futures, and FX including booking validation, settlement monitoring on CTM and Traiana and discrepancy resolution.
Acted as client-facing point of contact for new fund onboarding engagements, coordinating launch readiness, managing data integration into Arcesium's platform, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure seamless go-live across systems, workflows, and reporting.
Collaborated with Legal and Compliance teams on documentation including security tradeability approvals, corporate actions booking and stakeholder sign-offs within required regulatory and compliance frameworks.
Partnered with Product and Engineering teams on firm-wide data integration and platform improvement projects, contributing operational expertise to build scalable solutions that reduced manual effort and improved data quality across fund workflows.
Drove process automation and workflow enhancements using AI tools, Python, SQL, and Power BI, measurably reducing manual effort and operational risk across the team
Played a key role in launching two new funds ($4B and $120B AUM), managing end-to-end onboarding including Geneva configuration, prime broker setup, and full operational readiness.
Trained junior analysts on reconciliation processes, Accounting workflows, and fund operations standards, supporting onboarding and skill development
Oversaw monthly investor flow processing (subscriptions and redemptions) across all funds, ensuring accurate NAV impact, timely investor reporting, and adherence to fund documentation.
• Performed pre-upload validation of trade and fund data, validating security attributes, trade details, account mappings and reference data to ensure accurate processing and minimize downstream reconciliation breaks.
• Supported bulk trade/data uploads during new fund onboarding and system implementation, performing

data validation, mapping and exception checks to ensure successful integration into the Arcesium platform. Investigated and resolved upload-related exceptions and STP breaks, coordinating with Product, Engineering and Operations teams to address data, security setup and workflow issues before downstream processing.
Validated trade data prior to system processing, ensuring completeness and accuracy of security, quantity, price, currency, settlement and account-level information.
Managed treasury operations including collateral movements, margin monitoring across OTC derivatives and futures, and wire processing and monitoring zero margin breach incidents.
Served as primary liaison with Big Four external auditors and third-party administrators; delivered mid- year and year-end audits on time with zero escalations across 2 consecutive audit cycles.
Built ETL workflows in Python to automate data extraction and transformation across fund systems.
Analyst – Trade Accounting & Data Operations (FinOps) | Dec 2022 – Dec 2024
Performed daily cash, position, and trade reconciliations across a portfolio of 12+ hedge fund, managing break investigation and counterparty coordination to resolution within T+1 SLAs.
Established and maintained fund SSIs and SWIFT payment templates, ensuring accurate and secure settlement of fund transfers across counterparties.
Processed and validated corporate actions lifecycle : dividends, stock splits, mergers, and reorganizations across equity and fixed income holdings.
Prepared NAV calculations, financial statements, and investor reports for 12+ hedge fund; analysed fund performance and P&L movements to support accurate client deliverables.
Supported UAT testing, process documentation, and system implementation for new clients and platform
enhancements.
Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) / NYSE | Hyderabad | Nov 2021 – Nov 2022
Data Researcher I – Non-NA Region | Nov 2021 – Nov 2022
Analyzed and validated complex bond structures (convertibles, structured notes, ABS) across non-NA markets for ICE's fixed income data platform, supporting downstream pricing and analytics used by institutional clients.
Collected and transformed primary market issuance data from legal and financial documents, coordinating with underwriters, issuers, and exchanges to ensure data accuracy and timeliness.
Resolved client escalations on complex fixed income structures, maintaining high data quality standards and building foundational expertise in fixed income instruments that underpins current derivatives and multi- asset operations work.
EEDUCATION
MBA – Finance & Data Analytics2020 – 2022 Prestige Institute of Management & Research, Indore | Relevant coursework: Derivatives, Portfolio Management, Financial Modelling, Data Analytics
B.Com (Commerce)2017 – 2020 DAVV University, Indore
AACHIEVEMENTS & CERTIFICATIONS
Arcesium 2025 Spot Award — recognised for cross-team collaboration and process improvement contributions across fund operations.
Post Graduate Program in Security Analysis — NSE Academy • NISM Series-VII: Equity Derivatives Certification • Qq Series-XV: Research Analyst Certification • Algorithmic Trading Certification — Quantbot Securities Pvt. Ltd.
